cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll direct the sofa delivery. Give me a nod and I'll tell them we're taking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're in charge of measurements. Nod now and I'll keep everyone out of the way while you measure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The delivery men are waiting outside. They can measure it themselves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent delegation. We'll use them. Just give me the nod before you invite them to measure; I don't want their numbers complicating our decision.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs delivery; A3 adopts B measuring priority and A5 credits B delegation while repeatedly placing the nod before practical fit checks.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 measuring causes A3 assigned measurement; B4 workers availability causes A5 adopting them but delaying their check.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 solve a real fit uncertainty; A offers room and cooperation while preserving premature assent.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends the avoidance from B measurement to the professionals B proposes.

specificity.evidence: A1 sofa delivery and B2 doorway create a clear shared household decision.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 numbers-complicating phrase makes the evasion conspicuous, with a playable confident facade.
